P0.title: The process-idle gate misses the project's profile100, valid825, and validate naming families
P0.evidence: Runner lines 144-145 require a boundary immediately after profile or valid. Therefore profile100.py, valid825.py, validate.py, run_date11_ft5_and_valid825.py, and run_h67_ep35_profile100_bit_trace.py do not match. These naming families exist in the frozen project tree.
P0.risk: A queued or initializing GPU profile/validation process can exist during all four samples before it creates an nvidia-smi compute context; the runner can then consume the one-shot attempt and contend with that job, violating the contract's process-absence gate.
P0.required_fix: Extend the fail-closed matcher to cover project suffixes and aliases, at minimum profile[0-9]*, valid[0-9]*, validate, training/trainer/trainonly, and their path-boundary forms; refresh the runner SHA and repeat this static hammer.

P2.title: M716 P2-3 remains verbatim: randomized vectors are still labeled exhaustive-pattern
P2.evidence: Capture lines 128-153 use random.Random(714) and 256 randomized weight/value vectors while line 129 still says 'Deterministic exhaustive-pattern'. The fixed seed happens to draw all 256 scalar codes, but no explicit scalar exhaustion or coverage assertion exists.
P2.required_fix: Rename the comment/test classification to deterministic randomized algebra smoke test, or add an explicit range(-128,128) scalar exhaustion with a coverage assertion.
